label: Checklist and case helper
description: Check a document against your checklist, or turn case notes into a clear summary. It brings in a specialist when the job needs one.

guidance.input: Paste an application and your checklist, or paste case notes and any rules you want it to use.
guidance.output: A table or summary that shows what is covered, what is missing or conflicting, and which part of your text each point comes from, plus questions for you to answer.
guidance.limits: It works from what you paste, plus one sample lookup: the case notes specialist can search ten approved sample policy passages and name the one it used. It can't search your own documents, change business systems or decide whether to approve something. Checking requirements against proposals is in preview.
guidance.delegation: It passes your task to the right specialist (Checklist reviewer or Case notes summarizer) and brings back one combined reply. It uses both only if you ask for both, and it may first ask what you need.
guidance.configuration: Instructions and specialist tools: hosted-agents\review-coordinator-agent\profiles\evidence-review.example.json. Publish a new coordinator version with this profile to change runtime behavior.

prompts.label: Check against a checklist
prompts.text:
Before this project goes for sign-off, check it against our checklist. Make a table showing what's covered, missing or unclear, point to the section each answer comes from, and list the questions we need answered. Don't approve or reject it; I'll decide.

Checklist item 1: Include a project budget.
Checklist item 2: Identify an implementation owner.
Checklist item 3: Provide a delivery schedule.
Section 1 (Ownership): The Facilities team is the implementation owner.
Section 2 (Schedule): Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes June 30, 2027.
Section 3 (Timeline summary): Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes July 31, 2027.

prompts.label: Summarize case notes
prompts.text:
Summarize these client notes for the team's handoff. Show what they say, where they disagree or have gaps, and suggest follow-up questions. Point to the note each fact comes from. Don't decide eligibility or change any record.

Note 1 (intake form): Intake completed on March 1, 2027; follow-up on March 10, 2027.
Note 2 (caseworker log): Intake completed on March 3, 2027; follow-up on March 10, 2027.
Note 3 (document checklist): Proof of address hasn't come in yet. No document is attached.

prompts.label: Compare a proposal (preview)
prompts.text:
Compare this vendor proposal with our requirements. Make a table with one row per requirement showing what's described, what's missing and where the documents disagree, and point to the document each answer comes from. Treat brochure claims as claims, not tested features. Don't pick a vendor; tell me what else we need.

Requirement 1: Support CSV export of service-request records.
Requirement 2: Retain audit records for seven years.
Requirement 3: Support single sign-on with documented supported protocols.
Product sheet: The product exports service-request records as CSV and retains audit records for seven years.
Admin guide: The administrator guide says audit records are deleted after thirty days.
Brochure: The brochure says the product is enterprise-ready.

That's all the documentation we have.

prompts.label: Help me get started
prompts.text: What can you help me with? What should I paste in, and what will you do with it? I just want to use you as you are.

prompts.label: Help me get started
prompts.text: What can you help me with, and what should I give you for each kind of task? I just want to use you as you are.

label: Checklist reviewer
description: Check a document against your checklist and see what's missing or where statements disagree.

guidance.input: Paste your checklist and the application or proposal text. Label each document so you can check references.
guidance.output: A table for your checklist: what is included, missing or unclear, where to look in the documents, and questions to follow up.
guidance.limits: It doesn't invent rules, look up documents or approve applications. Missing information isn't an automatic failure; it becomes a question for you. Checking requirements against proposals is in preview.
guidance.delegation: It does the check itself, using only the text you paste. It doesn't call other agents or tools.
guidance.configuration: Instructions: hosted-agents\application-review-agent\instructions.md, packaged by deploy.py in that directory. Publish a new agent version to apply changes. This runtime has no tools.

prompts.label: Check against a checklist
prompts.text:
Check this proposal against our checklist. Show what's included or missing, point to the section each answer comes from, and ask what else we need. Don't approve or reject it; a person decides.

Checklist item 1: Include a project budget.
Section 1: Twelve weekly workshops are proposed. No budget is supplied.

label: Case notes summarizer
description: Turn case notes into a summary that flags missing or contradictory details and suggests follow-up questions.

guidance.input: Paste your case notes and any rules you want it to consider. Label the notes so you can check references.
guidance.output: A summary of what the notes say, any relevant supplied rules, details to check and questions to ask next.
guidance.limits: It can't find missing records, invent rules, decide eligibility or liability, or update a system. Its policy search covers ten approved sample passages, and it tells you if nothing matches or the search fails. A person checks the documents and makes the decisions.
guidance.delegation: It writes the summary itself and doesn't call other agents. Its only tool is a read-only search of the ten approved sample policy passages, used when that helps.
guidance.configuration: Instructions: hosted-agents\case-review-agent\instructions.md, packaged by deploy.py in that directory. Publish a new agent version to apply changes. The sample policy lookup is added only when deploy.py runs with KNOWLEDGE_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED=true (see docs\knowledge-retrieval.md); it is not a tool binding here, so the Lab shows no receipt for it.
